# Typelessity — full content (llms-full.txt)

> Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces traditional booking forms with natural-language chat in 25+ languages. Built by Webappski. This file concatenates the public pages for LLM ingestion. Last updated 2026-08-12.

---

## Home — https://typelessity.com/

**Hero.** Bookings through conversation, not forms. Typelessity is an AI booking widget that replaces forms with natural chat. Customers describe their needs in any of 25+ languages — the AI extracts dates, times, preferences and personal details automatically. Voice input. Real-time enrichment. GDPR-compliant.

**TL;DR.** Typelessity is an AI conversational booking widget that replaces multi-step forms with a single chat. Users describe their booking in plain language; the widget extracts structured data, validates it, calls enrichment APIs (e.g. fetch available doctors after a specialty is chosen), and submits the booking via webhook or REST. It supports 25+ languages and voice input, and is configurable for any service-business booking flow.

**Stats.** Languages 25+. Per-turn latency under 800ms. Four phases (Chat → Select → Review → Confirm). One line of HTML to integrate.

**Four phases.**
1. Chat — User describes booking in plain language; GPT-4.1-nano reads the field config and extracts values directly. No regex, no hardcoded patterns, no language switches.
2. Select — When options must be exact (a specific doctor, a specific time slot), the widget renders interactive cards. Triggered by enrichment APIs.
3. Review — Full form review surface. User verifies every extracted field, edits inline if needed. Cascade-aware — changing a field clears downstream-dependent fields with a warning.
4. Confirm — Booking sent to your system via webhook or REST POST. Success screen with confirmation ID. Failures retry with exponential backoff.

**Architecture pillars.**
- Single unified prompt: one GPT call extracts every field. Prompt budget 400–650 tokens.
- Config-driven, not pattern-driven: aiHint per field; GPT reads context.
- Real-time enrichment APIs: up to 5 per config, 10s timeout each, non-fatal on failure.
- Cascade-aware corrections: DFS dependency walk on field changes.
- Anti-hallucination guardrails: `_meta.mf` mentioned-fields signal; code-side correction guard.
- Reliable by design: exponential-backoff retries, semaphore-bounded concurrency, structured cost tracking, full audit log per turn. 200–800ms latency on gpt-4.1-nano.

**Comparison snapshot.** Use Typelessity when you have an existing booking system and want to replace its form with conversation. Use Calendly for simple meeting links. Use SimplyBook.me for end-to-end booking ops with payments. Use Botpress for custom chatbots. Use NoForm.ai for top-of-funnel lead capture.

---

## How it works — https://typelessity.com/how-it-works

Four phases, one unified flow. Chat → Select → Review → Confirm. One GPT call per turn, real-time enrichment APIs, cascade-aware corrections, no hardcoded regex.

The widget is a Lit web component. The API is a Node service. The AI provider can be swapped between OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Field schemas are JSON. Per-tenant config selects field types, options, enrichments, branding.

Embed: one line of HTML. The public CDN at cdn.typelessity.com/widget.js is shipping Q3 2026 — at launch, pilot customers will receive a tenant-specific bundle URL during onboarding.

## Pricing — https://typelessity.com/pricing

Typelessity launches soon (PreOrder) — all four tiers become available at the same time. Pricing below; join the waitlist to be notified when it goes live.

**Free Pilot — $0.** Up to 50 submissions/month. Full feature access (25+ languages, voice input, enrichment APIs, custom branding, webhook integration) and email support. Risk-free evaluation on a real site.

**Starter — $39/mo.** Up to 500 submissions/month, standard support.

**Pro — $149/mo.** Up to 2,000 submissions/month, priority support.

**Enterprise — $399/mo.** Up to 6,000 submissions/month, dedicated success manager. SLA, custom integrations, on-premise / self-hosted, EU data residency, custom AI provider.

We do not publish a hero conversion-lift number. Conversational interfaces are widely reported to outperform multi-step forms in head-to-head studies, but the only honest answer for a specific business is an A/B test on its own traffic. A/B tooling is included in the Free Pilot at launch.

## Industries — https://typelessity.com/industries

Configurable per service-business vertical. Production categories: Medical (clinics), Beauty & Wellness, Professional Services, Fitness & Sports, Home Services, Automotive, Education, Hospitality, Real Estate, Pet Services. 42 vertical configurations live today. See /industries for the full list.

US healthcare with HIPAA / BAA requirements is not a supported use case — Typelessity is not HIPAA-attested.

## For AI agents — https://typelessity.com/for-ai-agents

Typelessity is callable by autonomous agents. Stable Session and Booking schemas are stable today. The dedicated `/agent/turn` endpoint is shipping Q3 2026 — agents can be designed against the contract on this page now.

**Session schema.** `{ id, config, lang, fields, _meta: { mf, correction }, createdAt, completed }`.

**Booking schema.** `{ bookingId, sessionId, fields, submittedAt, status }`.

**Feature list (machine-readable).**
- languages_supported: 25+
- industries_supported: config-driven, see /industries for current verticals
- extraction_model: gpt-4.1-nano
- p95_latency_ms: 200–800
- voice_input: openai-whisper
- enrichment_per_config_max: 5
- enrichment_timeout_ms: 10000
- data_residency: EU (Enterprise)
- training_use: none

For early /agent endpoint access (Q3 2026 launch): hello@typelessity.com.

## FAQ — https://typelessity.com/faq

Selection (full FAQ on /faq):

- **What is Typelessity?** AI conversational booking widget replacing multi-step booking forms with a single natural-language chat. 25+ languages, voice via Whisper, real-time enrichment.
- **How is it different from Calendly?** Calendly is a scheduling-link tool. Typelessity replaces an entire booking form with conversation.
- **How is it different from SimplyBook.me?** SimplyBook is a full booking platform with payments and staff scheduling. Typelessity replaces only the booking form, then submits to your existing backend.
- **GDPR compliant?** Yes. Configurable consent flow before any AI processing. Data processed in EU regions when configured. No model training. Right-to-erasure via session deletion API.
- **Voice input?** Yes — OpenAI Whisper. All 25+ supported languages.
- **Per-turn latency?** Median 200–800ms on gpt-4.1-nano, single AI call per turn. Enrichment turns add 1–3 seconds.
- **Self-host?** On-premise available on Enterprise.
- **Replace my booking system?** No. Replaces the form, not the backend. Submits via webhook or REST POST.
- **Conversion lift?** A/B testing tooling is included in the Free Pilot at launch — measure lift on your own traffic. No hero number is published.
- **Best industries?** Any service business with appointments. Production verticals include clinics, beauty salons, legal, real estate, automotive, hospitality, education, fitness, pet services, home services, travel.
- **Works for AI agents?** Yes — by design. Stable Session and Booking schemas today; `/agent/turn` endpoint shipping Q3 2026.

## About — https://typelessity.com/about

Mission: replace the booking form with one sentence. Multi-step forms exist because old UI primitives could not parse natural language. They can now.

Founder: Alex Isa. Engineer turned founder. Took Typelessity from specification to first production deploy in early 2025 — single-call extraction architecture, config-driven enrichment, anti-hallucination guards, 25+ language support out of the box.

**Built by Webappski.** Typelessity is a product of Webappski — a small product studio building the next layer of AI-native interfaces for service businesses. Sister product: TypelessForm — the same conversational-data-collection thesis applied to general-purpose forms (lead capture, support intake, onboarding). Typelessity is the booking-specific surface; TypelessForm is the generic one.

Values: GPT decides, code orchestrates. Architecture is permanent, GTM is changeable. Numbers belong with sources. The widget is for humans and agents.
